description: Keep dependency updates for the pdd-kit package, its viewer and the pdd-kit.dev site predictable and reviewable: one weekly batch, majors on request, security fixes at once.

packageRules.description: Group patch and minor dependency updates into one PR.
Each major update can break on its own terms, so it waits on the Dependency Dashboard until it is requested. Security updates are not held.
GitHub Actions updates, majors included, are low risk and exercised by CI, so they share one PR.
The supported Node range is a promise to consumers, raised deliberately, never by a dependency update.
@types/node describes the oldest Node the code must run on, its engines floor, never the newest release or the Node CI installs. Its major is raised by hand along with that floor.
The site's engines floor is Node 22, so its @types/node stays on 22 for the same reason.
Workflows name a Node major and take its latest release; pinning the patch only adds churn, and a new major is a deliberate change.
The e2e job's container image must match @playwright/test, so they update together, in their own PR.
Playwright image tags are a v-prefixed version with an Ubuntu suffix.

customManagers.description: The deploy jobs run a pinned Wrangler through npx.
